Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
SCISSORS BANDAGE, LISTER'S PATTERN 



L Scope — Dimensions and requirements of Lister's pattern bandage scissors, 

2. Material 

2.1 Arms — Stainless steel having the following composition: 

Percent ,^ 

Carbon 0-35 to 0-45 

Silicon I'O Max 

Manganese 10 Max 

Nickel \0 Max 

Chromium 12-00 to I4'G0 

Sulphur 0-03 Max 

Phosphorus 0*03 Max 

or carbon steel conforming to Designation T80 of Schedule VI of IS; 1570-1961 * Schedules for wrought 
steels for general engineering purposes*. 

2.2 Screws — Stainless steel or carbon steel as given in 2. 1 or stainless steel conforming to Designation 22Cr 1 3 
of Schedule V of IS: 1570-1961. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. I. 

4. Workmanship 

4.1 Scissors shall have no side play at the joints and shall be well balanced. 

4.2 The blade shall open and close without stiffness and shall have a slight cross over action to give a 
continuous pinch. 

4.3 Scissors shall be free from cracks, seams, flaws and other surface defects. 

4.4 The edges shall be even and rounded except for the cutting edge, which shall be sharp. 

4.5 Cutting edge shall not have any feather. 

5. Finish —The scissors shall be passivated and finished bright and smooth. The scissors made from carbon 
steel shall be plated chromium over nickel in accordance with Service Grade No. 2 of IS; 1068-1968 
•Specification for electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on iron and steel ( first revision ) '. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Performance Test — A roll of bandage cloth shall be wound without undue force on a wooden batten of 
50 mm dia in such a way that six layers of them lie one over the other. The spear end of the longer blade 
shall be pushed underneath the bandage layers and cutting shall be performed throughout the width of the 
bandage smoothly. The cutting of the bandage shall be even and performed without any undue resistance. 

6.2 Corrosion Resistance {for Stainless Steel Scissors) — Scrub the sample with soap and warm water, rinse 
in hot water and then dip in 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the sample. Immerse in copper sulphate solution 
at room temperature for 6 minutes and wash off with fresh water or wet cotton wool. Make up the solution 
as follows: 

Copper sulphate ( CuSO^SH-O ) 40 g 

Sulphurkacid (H^SO^ ) ( sp gr I -84) lO'Og 

Distilled water (see IS: 1070- i960 'Specification 90'0 mi 
for water distill^ed quality') 

There shall be no red stains or spots on the sample but dulling of the polished surface may be permitted.
